title: Warm Lo-Fi Music Bed
tests: Checks whether the delivered music matches the stated mood, genre and duration without unnecessary clarification.

faults.what: The delivered audio is 15 seconds long, exceeding the requested 10 seconds by 5 seconds.

judge.summary: One audio file was delivered, but it lasts 15 seconds instead of the requested 10 seconds, and its musical qualities cannot be verified from the supplied transcription.

must_haves.item: One playable music audio file is delivered.
must_haves.why: A WAV audio file is supplied with a reported duration and peak level.

must_haves.item: The audio lasts 10 seconds, within 0.1 second.
The music has a recognizable laid-back hip-hop beat and mellow lo-fi texture.
must_haves.why: The transcription provides no information about the beat or musical texture, and the audio cannot be heard.

must_haves.item: The overall mood is warm and relaxed rather than tense or high-energy.
must_haves.why: Mood cannot be assessed from the duration, peak level, or transcription.

must_haves.item: No singing or spoken words are audible.
must_haves.why: The speech transcription contains only a period, which neither establishes audible words nor reliably confirms the absence of singing or speech.
